title: Account follow-up standards
text: LSK account managers review distributor renewal dates, confirm quoted commercial terms with a human owner, and document follow-up tasks. The assistant does not approve pricing.

title: Brand campaign interpretation
text: LSK campaign analysis uses source-system impressions, clicks, conversions and spend; campaign KPIs are computed by the Marketing service. AI narrative is advisory.

title: Commercial invoice exception review
text: LSK invoice variance requires validation against purchase orders and receipts; a finance reviewer resolves exceptions. AI may summarize but cannot issue payments or authorize ledger changes.
